item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Geo-redundancy on Azure App Service
item.description:
Azure App Service geo-redundancy is now in public preview. It lets customers build more resilient web apps across Azure regions without having to separately create and manage an App Service deployment in each region.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Azure App Service on Azure Stack Hub
item.description:
Azure App Service on Azure Stack Hub will be retired on September 30, 2029. From September 30, 2026, new installations are no longer supported and the product will receive no new releases, features, or enhancements.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Support for Java 8, 11 and 17 will end on September 1, 2027
item.description:
Azure App Service will end support for Java 8, 11, and 17 on September 1, 2027. Apps will keep running, but security updates and customer support for those Java versions will stop.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: azure: Retirement: Support for Node 22 LTS ends on April 30, 2027
item.description:
Support for Node 22 LTS on Azure App Service ends April 30, 2027. Apps will keep running after that date, but security updates and customer support for Node 22 LTS will stop.

  • Source: Azure Updates
